title: 「Main clause, only to + verb」表達「意料之外的結果」
titleZh: 「Main clause, only to + verb」表達「意料之外的結果」
titleEn: Using “Main clause, only to + verb” for an unexpected result

source.file: Sentence Structure 267 -「Main clause, only to + verb」表達意料之外的結果.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF does not provide a complete English counterpart, the English text is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than the system lesson because two distinct source PDFs are labelled 201; source number N therefore maps to system ID ssN+1.

formula: Main clause, only to + base verb + other information.

formulas.formula: Subject + verb, only to + base verb.
Subject + verb, only to be + past participle.
Introductory phrase, subject + verb, only to + base verb.
Subject + may / can / could + verb, only to + base verb.
Subject + verb + to + purpose, only to + verb showing the actual result.

exampleZh: 他趕往車站，結果卻發現火車已經開走了。

meaning.zh: 此句型表示某人先做了一件事，但其後出現意料之外的實際結果；結果通常令人失望、不方便或驚訝。

rules.zh: only to 在此表示意外結果，不表示目的；普通 to + 動詞則可解釋某人為何做前面的行動。
rules.en: Only to expresses an unexpected result here, not a purpose. An ordinary to-infinitive may explain why the preceding action was performed.

rules.zh: 表示意外結果時，only to 前通常使用逗號；沒有逗號的 only to 有時表示唯一目的，意思不同。
rules.en: For the unexpected-result structure, only to is normally preceded by a comma. Without the comma, only to may express a sole purpose and have a different meaning.

rules.zh: to 後必須使用動詞原形，例如 only to find、discover、realise、learn 或 receive。
rules.en: Use the base form after to, as in only to find, discover, realise, learn or receive.

rules.zh: 被動結果使用 only to be + 過去分詞，例如 only to be told、asked、refused 或 turned away。
rules.en: Use only to be + past participle for a passive result, such as only to be told, asked, refused or turned away.

rules.zh: 前後兩部分通常由同一主語承擔，即前面行動者也是經歷意外結果的人。
rules.en: The same subject normally carries both parts: the person performing the first action is also the person experiencing the unexpected result.

rules.zh: 結果必須真正意料之外；正常、可預計的下一步行動不適合此句型。
rules.en: The result must genuinely be unexpected. A normal, predictable next action is unsuitable for this structure.

rules.zh: 結果通常負面，但也可以只是令人驚訝而非不幸。
rules.en: The result is often negative, but it may simply be surprising rather than unfortunate.

rules.zh: 本課不包括 only for + noun + to + verb、only + V-ing、only to have + 過去分詞，或表示「唯一目的」的 only to。
rules.en: This lesson does not cover only for + noun + to + verb, only + V-ing, only to have + past participle, or only to used for a sole purpose.

benefits.zh: 它清楚顯示人物原本期望和實際結果之間的反差。
benefits.en: It clearly shows the contrast between an expectation and the actual result.

benefits.zh: 它把行動和意外結果濃縮成一句，使表達比兩個短句更緊湊。
benefits.en: It condenses an action and its unexpected result into one compact sentence.

benefits.zh: 把意外結果放在句尾，讓讀者先看到行動再看到出乎意料的結局，令敘事更有戲劇性。
benefits.en: It makes stories and experiences more dramatic by placing the unexpected outcome at the end.

benefits.zh: 它提供另一種表達反差的方法，避免反覆使用 but、however 和 unfortunately。
benefits.en: It avoids repeated use of but, however and unfortunately by offering another way to express contrast.

benefits.zh: 它適合描述失敗、誤會和出乎意料的發現，常見於故事、新聞、個人經歷、投訴信和正式敘述。
benefits.en: It is suitable for failures, misunderstandings and unexpected discoveries in stories, news, personal experiences, complaint letters and formal narratives.

benefits.zh: 它能在同一句先交代目的，再以 only to 說明真正結果，幫助分清目的和實際結果。
benefits.en: It helps distinguish purpose from actual result by allowing a purpose first and then the real outcome with only to.
